developer: University of Illinois / National Center for Supercomputing Applications
status_detail: NCSA says the 88,000-square-foot NPCF houses computing, networking, and data systems, with high-reliability power/cooling, 1/10/40/100 GbE connections, up to 440 GbE external connectivity, LEED Gold certification, and on-site cooling towers.
notes: Research/HPC facility rather than commercial hyperscale; included because it is explicitly described locally as an existing data center facility.

status_detail: Champaign County created a Data Center Activities Task Force and considered/adopted a 12-month moratorium for large data center permits. Local reporting says serious inquiries included a Rising Road area west of Champaign and an approximately 313-acre center proposed in Mahomet, but no applicant name or formal application was disclosed.
notes: Early/opaque pre-application activity; county official page confirms task force and moratorium context but not a named project.

project_name: Eagle Rock Christian County data center campus
status_detail: Eagle Rock Partners proposed an $8.8 billion data center campus in Christian County. Reporting and EDA event materials describe a 475-acre site near Taylorville/Bear Creek Township, ten 100 MW buildings, more than 1,000 construction jobs, hundreds of permanent jobs, and earliest construction around 2028-2030 if approved.
notes: Christian County had a temporary data-center construction restriction/moratorium while regulations are developed; sources indicate the project had not yet received final county land-use approval.
